messages:
mike_ap: FYI incoming vendor invoice INV-88217 from Apex Cloud for $41,700. No PO on header, line notes mention PO-4512 but attached PDF shows "Redwood Labs" as payee. PDF: https://files.redwood/apex/INV-88217.pdf

alyssa_fin: Tried to match in AP, system rejects because header entity doesn't match our vendor record. No PO found in Coupa.

approver-bot: Routing failed — cost center '8001' not mapped to any approver. Error ID: ERR-AC-903. See /approvals logs.

rohan_proc: @mike_ap @alyssa_fin I need either a confirmed PO number or a statement of work to route this. Can vendor confirm legal entity and provide line-level cost centers?

apex_support: Apex Support: sorry about the mixup — invoice tool pulled the old legal name. We see PO-4512 in our notes but will reissue with correct payee (Redwood Inc) and include explicit CCs. ETA EOD.

jess_product: Product note: the work is split infra vs feature dev. If vendor can split lines (ENG vs PRODUCT) we can map to the right GL buckets.

mike_ap: If vendor can attach the original PO scan and reissue with Redwood Inc we can consider a manual temp approve. Need sign-off from @alyssa_fin + procurement.

alyssa_fin: I can approve a one-off conditional release if Procurement signs off. @rohan_proc please confirm you can accept a temporary routing note and create placeholder PO.

rohan_proc: I can create PO-99999 (placeholder) to let AP process payment hold release, but vendor must reference PO-99999 in their reissued invoice and include a short memo: "TEMP-APPROVE: pending PO reissue".

apex_support: Confirmed — we will reissue invoice as INV-88217v2, reference PO-99999 in header, include line splits and attach credit memo 23-04 ($5,300). Uploading in ~2 hours.

mike_ap: Thanks. Also FYI vendor applied an early-payment discount on the original; AP didn't auto-apply. Alyssa can you confirm discount terms once v2 arrives?

alyssa_fin: Will verify. Holding payment until v2 is matched to PO-99999 and GL split is clear. Looping in @finance-lead for conditional approval.

finance-lead: Conditional approval granted: release payment once reissued invoice matches PO-99999 and line-level cost centers map to ENG/PRODUCT. Please include note in payment stub.

mike_ap: I'll mark this as blocked in the pay-run queue and wait for the v2 upload.

apex_support: Uploaded INV-88217_v2 and credit memo: https://files.redwood/apex/INV-88217_v2.pdf

mike_ap: Received file. Quick view of lines:
``` 
INV-88217v2
1) Infra support — $20,000 — CC 8001 (ENG)
2) Feature dev — $16,400 — CC 7002 (PRODUCT)
3) Credit memo 23-04 — -$5,300
Total: $41,100
```

mike_ap: Looks like a $600 discrepancy vs original total — apex_support can you confirm math? Also need confirmation vendor kept the early-pay discount.

apex_support: Apologies, typo on line 2. Should be $16,700. Re-uploading corrected PDF momentarily.

apex_support: Re-upload done: INV-88217_v2b.pdf — totals now reconcile to $41,700 and PO-99999 is referenced in header.

approver-bot: Routing succeeded — approver assigned: alyssa_fin. Approval chain complete.

alyssa_fin: Approved. Proceed with payment on next run, apply credit memo and early-pay discount per vendor terms.

mike_ap: Processing match to PO-99999 now. I'll log payment scheduled for next AP run and attach vendor note.

mike_ap: Payment scheduled. Closing thread — reopen if payment fails or vendor disputes amount.

apex_support: Thanks everyone — will confirm when funds post. Sorry for the churn :pray:
